_about: Editable inputs for studies/model/testfit.mjs. Status of each block is stated; see studies/assumptions.json for ids.

height.status: exploratory (E-FTF-RES, E-FTF-GROUND, E-ROOF); the CDO height-measurement method is not analysed

peaks.status: Floor counts from the Trinity Peaks v1.3 description (5-6 residential floors over a partly below-grade ground floor) plus a low-rise alternative tested against the 55-ft ceiling. The hidden duplex level is not modelled.

rise.status: exploratory: all four-bedroom units (Option A), double-loaded, 6-ft corridor, 30-ft core and stair zone

site.status: external, approximate: 'roughly 21 acres' as reported in 2022 coverage cited on trinityredistricting.com (context.html; VTDigger and Seven Days). Parcel boundaries, retained buildings, and buffers are not surveyed.
site.coverageSource: Burlington CDO Sec. 4.5.2(e), 40% lot coverage as reported in Trinity facts 'zoning_current' (not a legal review)
